bom.part: PU surfboard foam blank with wood stringer
bom.description: Shaped 7'6" (2286 mm) beginner-stability outline with rocker and soft rails; finished board dimensions approximately 2286 × 560 × 210 mm.
Fibreglass reinforcement cloth for the board laminate; cut and applied during glassing.
Resin system for laminating and sealing the PU foam and fibreglass; quantity sufficient for one board.
Compatible fin boxes installed in the tail for a thruster setup.
Removable fins compatible with the installed fin boxes; one center and two side fins.
Abrasives and finishing supplies used to sand and finish one glassed board.
Long carton sized to protect one 7'6" surfboard during shipping.
Board wrap and cushioning for protection inside the shipping carton.
